source_ref: Wording: https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos/programas/ensu/doc/ensu2025_cuest_principal.zip (sha256 55db60ddb22c3fcc85c4d6cc69cc7f89d8f3523a4a34719556def765dcf92d38, copied from the batch_697 cache and hash re-checked 2026-09-28; same zip as batch_689/693/697) -> ensu2025_trim4_cuest_principal.pdf (ENSU 2025 Cuarto trimestre, Cuestionario principal, Seccion II, pp.3-4; sha256 bf49cbca1f8ce151c69af71f1afcb7c9facb4a3e62f21b010494eff124b40a8b). Mapping/labels: https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos/programas/ensu/datosabiertos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_2025_4t_csv.zip (sha256 0a3c171799029f052651bb41ad484678a892f5c5bd7fbbddc8c50533a27b4d7f, fetched 2026-09-28), conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_1225/diccionario_de_datos/diccionario_de_datos_ensu_cb_1225.csv (variable labels), catalogos/bp2_*.csv (value labels) and conjunto_de_datos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_1225.csv (raw data, sha256 7a8fcb2e7e9a86dfe2a1d0995c177dc07720d7163f643f2c6f84962c511674ca). Step 3b comparators: Q3 2025 = ensu2025_trim3_cuest_principal.pdf from the same zip; Q4 2024 = ensu2024_trim4_cuest_principal.pdf (from ensu2024_cuest_principal.zip sha256 3d9ac8514c3cfe561ff94f48592d7c8078bd22e309530146e384a5947410c788, batch_685 cache).
note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #15, Q4 2025 Conflicts; exports mexico_2025_q4safety_conflicts.csv from mexico_safety_4q2025.dta, built from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_1225.csv imported lowercased, id = _n within the quarter) keeps INEGI columns bp2_1..bp2_4_11 and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); keep list identical to Q3's Bookmark #10; recodes (Section II, all quarters): bp2_1 9 -> missing, bp2_3_* 9 -> missing; bp2_2_*/bp2_4_* have no missing codes. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's own 2025 Q4 data dictionary labels each BP2_* column (e.g. BP2_2_16 'Conflictos o enfrentamientos: Grafiti o pintas a su casa por alguien que usted identifique'; BP2_3_4 'Incidentes o problemas con desconocidos(as) en la calle'; BP2_4_09 'Tipo de consecuencias derivadas de conflictos: Dialogo/platica'); 37/37 agree in content with the Q4 questionnaire option carrying the same code number. Step 3b, 2025 Q4 vs 2025 Q3 (checked, not assumed): same 37 BP2_* variables; all 82 BP2_* diccionario rows identical to Q3 2025's (0925); all 37 catalogos/bp2_*.csv byte-identical to Q3 2025's. Questionnaire Section II: CP2 introduction, 2.1-2.4 stems and 35 of 36 option texts identical to the Q3 print; ONE print change, confirmed on a 150-dpi render of p.4 and shipped as printed: 2.3 option 3 now reads 'Companeros(as) de trabajo/escuela' (Q3 2025 'Companeros(as) de trabajo / escuela'; slash spacing only, reverting to the 2024 Q4 form). Step 3b, 2025 Q4 vs 2024 Q4 (batch_685): three print differences, all slash/parenthesis spacing, all shipped as printed in Q4 2025: 2.2 option 12 'conflicto en la compra / consumo de producto / servicio en un establecimiento comercial?' (2024 Q4 'compra/consumo de producto/servicio'); 2.2 option 15 'prepotencia de un (una) servidor(a) publico(a)?' (2024 Q4 'un(a)'); 2.4 option 9 'Dialogo/platica' (2024 Q4 'Dialogo / platica'). 2.3 option 3 identical to 2024 Q4. The 2.4 option 5 line again shows a leading ellipsis glyph before the dot leader ('etcetera)...05'); treated as part of the leader and stripped, as batch_697. All 38 distinct Spanish strings shipped are found in the Q4 2025 text layer (pdftotext, non-layout) after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 74 live item x level counts (server-side GROUP BY item,resp, no export) equal the raw INEGI 2025 Q4 CSV after the .do's recodes, 74/74 (e.g. bp2_1 1/2 = 9957/13956, bp2_2_01 0/1 = 6522/3435, bp2_2_16 0/1 = 9214/743, bp2_2_18 0/1 = 8264/1693, bp2_3_2 0/1 = 2276/5973, bp2_4_09 0/1 = 3521/4743). Raw 23923 rows (PER=0425 on every row), 10 bp2_1=9 set missing -> 23913 live distinct ids = live bp2_1 n; live COUNT(*) 351786 = 23913 + 18x9957 + 7x8249 + 11x8264, no missing resp, no duplicate id x item; 15 respondents coded 9 on all seven bp2_3_* set missing (bp2_3 n = 8249 vs bp2_4 n = 8264). Not truncated. Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials), not the terser dictionary labels. Kept as printed: '(as)' gender fills, 'un (una)', trailing '?' on 2.2 options, the stem's trailing ellipsis, slash spacing. Normalised: line wraps joined. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blanks after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'B' Y CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO / LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; PASE A LA SECCION III; SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 18 'NINGUNO', PASE A LA SECCION III). Structure (same as batch_680/685/689/693/697): section _1 = 2.1 screener (stem in item_text), _2 = 2.2 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _3 = 2.3, _4 = 2.4; instructions = CP2 read-aloud introduction. Options: bp2_1 1=Si, 2=No (questionnaire and catalogo; 9 set missing by the .do, no row). The 36 checklist items are 0/1 flags; option_text is INEGI's catalogo value label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si'), not questionnaire print. Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Routing (not a defect): 2.2 asked only if 2.1=Si (n=9957 = bp2_1 Si count); 2.3/2.4 skipped when 2.2 code 18 'Ninguno' was circled (8264 = 9957 - 1693). Step 3b table check: live items match this question block exactly (37 = 1 + 18 + 7 + 11); dictionary Description ('Q4 2025') accurate, but the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q4 (diciembre 2025, file suffix 1225) wave -- same defect as the siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation): 72/74 rows reused verbatim from batch_697 (Q3 2025, where the Spanish is identical); bp2_3_3's 2 rows take batch_685's (Q4 2024) 'Co-workers/schoolmates', whose Spanish matches the Q4 2025 print. Nothing translated fresh. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire. Rights: instrument_rights_register.csv INEGI row verdict=ship (Ben 2026-09-23, irw#2381 R01; INEGI Terminos de libre uso, attribution only), applied not re-derived; credit condition applied in public_note.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, cuarto trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section II (questions 2.1-2.4) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
